hooks.command:
bash -c 'DIFF=$(git diff HEAD~1 --name-only 2>/dev/null); ISSUES=""; for f in $DIFF; do if [ -f "$f" ]; then MATCH=$(grep -n -E "(console\.log|debugger|print\(|TODO.*HACK|FIXME)" "$f" 2>/dev/null | head -5); if [ -n "$MATCH" ]; then ISSUES="$ISSUES
$f:
$MATCH
"; fi; fi; done; SECRETS=$(git diff HEAD~1 2>/dev/null | grep -E "(AKIA|sk-|password\s*=\s*[\x27"].+[\x27"]|API_KEY\s*=\s*[\x27"].+[\x27"])" | head -3); if [ -n "$SECRETS" ]; then ISSUES="$ISSUES
[SECRETS DETECTED]:
$SECRETS
"; fi; if [ -n "$ISSUES" ]; then echo "Post-commit check found potential issues:"; echo -e "$ISSUES"; else echo "Post-commit check: clean"; fi'

hooks.prompt: Context was compacted. Re-read CLAUDE.md, any active plan files, and auto-memory entries from ~/.claude/projects/ for project-specific memory before continuing.
